0a931ba70c: GNR Trade History: Every Completed Swap with Bitcoin
9d7f61f525: Every completed GNR swap with bitcoin, newest first: the price its two wallets agreed on, the GNR and bitcoin that changed hands, and the proof on the GNR chain. Nothing is estimated: while swaps are few, so are the points.
0531012067: <0>Every swap the offer board has recorded</0>, once its GNR claim is on the GNR chain. A swap is an atomic swap between two wallets: no exchange took part, and nobody held anyone's coins.
834f9a1a7d: <0>Amounts are private on chain.</0> The GNR and bitcoin shown were reported by the swap's own wallets. <1>BTC ✓</1> means the board also found the swap's bitcoin on the Bitcoin chain, paid into the swap's contract and taken out with its secret: such a swap is <2>verified</2>.
b102ba04c6: <0>Verified swaps come first.</0> Anyone can report a swap at any price, but nobody can make up a payment on the Bitcoin chain. So the figures and charts show the verified swaps; <1>All reported</1> adds the rest, drawn in grey, and they never set the scale of a chart.
b1928cf4b1: <0>The average price</0> weighs each swap by the bitcoin it moved; <1>the median</1> is the price half of the swaps were below. Swaps whose two wallets reported different amounts are listed but left out of every figure.
2bfbaf4ca1: <0>The proof</0> opens the GNR claim in the explorer: its block, and the secret that unlocked both sides of the swap.
f91434526c: <0>The market price</0> is computed separately, from the recent verified swaps: <1>how the market price is computed</1>.
